column1: # manifests/plugins.tsv — the plugin allowlist. Deliberately short.
# Plugins bundle far more than a single capability, so a tool earns a row here
# only when it cannot be expressed as a skill plus an MCP server. `zephyr-ai`
# qualifies: it ships an indexed Zephyr tree, an MCP server over that index, and
# subagents, none of which the skill or MCP formats carry.
# The sync installs what is listed and *reports* anything installed that is not.
# It never uninstalls: a plugin you added by hand is a decision, not drift.
